tagline: Leading owner and operator of high-quality, open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties in the United States.
hero_kpi_rationale: As a REIT specializing in grocery-anchored open-air shopping centers, portfolio occupancy rate is the key KPI that reflects the company's operational health and leasing performance, directly tied to revenue generation and cash flow stability.
company_description: Kimco Realty Corporation is a real estate investment trust and leading owner and operator of high-quality, open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties in the United States. The company's portfolio is strategically concentrated in the first-ring suburbs of the top major metropolitan markets, including high-barrier-to-entry coastal markets and Sun Belt cities. Its tenant mix is focused on essential, necessity-based goods and services that drive multiple shopping trips per week. Publicly traded on the NYSE since 1991 and included in the S&P 500 Index, the company has specialized in shopping center ownership, management, acquisitions, and value-enhancing redevelopment activities for more than 65 years. With a proven commitment to corporate responsibility, Kimco Realty is a recognized industry leader in this area. As of December 31, 2025, the company owned interests in 565 U.S. shopping centers and mixed-use assets comprising 100 million square feet of gross leasable space. Kimco Realty Corporation was incorporated in 1958 and is based in Jericho, United States.

risks.title: Major Tenant Default Risks
risks.summary: Concentration with major tenants exposes the Company to credit default risks.
risks.score_rationale: The inability of major tenants to pay rent due to bankruptcy, insolvency, or economic difficulties could significantly reduce the Company's revenues.

risks.title: E-commerce and Consumer Behavior Change Risks
risks.summary: The Company must adapt to retail sector transformation trends.
risks.score_rationale: The impact of e-commerce and changes in retail shopping practices could reduce demand for physical retail space.

risks.title: Financing and Capital Markets Access Risks
risks.summary: The Company depends on capital markets to fund its operations and acquisitions.
risks.score_rationale: The inability to access capital markets or refinance debt on favorable terms could compromise investment and growth capacity.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risks
risks.summary: Interest rate volatility presents a risk to profitability and valuation.
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations affect the Company's financing costs and asset values.

risks.title: Climate Risks and Extreme Weather Events
risks.summary: The Company must manage physical damage risks and cost increases related to climate events.
risks.score_rationale: Climate-related physical risks, including storms, floods, and fires, could damage properties and increase operating and insurance costs.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.summary: The Company must comply with a complex and evolving regulatory environment.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in government laws, particularly regarding data privacy, environment, and health, could affect operations and increase costs.

risks.title: Cyber and Information Security Risks
risks.summary: The Company must protect its IT systems and sensitive data against growing threats.
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks, data losses, or other security incidents could disrupt operations and cause reputational damage.

risks.title: UPREIT Structure and REIT Status Risks
risks.summary: The Company must maintain its REIT qualification to benefit from favorable tax treatment.
risks.score_rationale: The inability to maintain REIT status or risks associated with the UPREIT structure could have negative tax implications.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.summary: The Company must maintain a good reputation and integrate corporate responsibility standards.
risks.score_rationale: Corporate responsibility issues, including environmental and social concerns, could affect reputation and attractiveness to investors.
